summary: The library now builds the pipelines.home image from docs/Dockerfile: a strict MkDocs build plus check_site.py in the builder, nginx on :80 serving the landing page at / and the docs under /docs/, relative redirects, nginx -t at build time, all witnessed in a test build. The root Jenkinsfile follows image-build.groovy, passes the linter and is held in kc project lint. IaC/JenkinsPipelineUtils was created through the API with GitHubPushTrigger and its config.xml saved; its first build waits for the test phase's push.
